background: The Bank of Nova Scotia is one of Canada's big six banks and the most international of them, funded by Canadian deposits and wholesale markets and lending in Canada, the United States, Mexico, Peru, Chile and the Caribbean.
synthesis: Rated A+ on average across all three, the weakest of them at A, all on a stable outlook; the last move was a three-notch downgrade by one of the three on 24 Sep 2018. Capital is solid if not leading among Canadian banks: CET1 of 13.1% is below the peer median, while leverage of 4.3% is in the top quarter. None of the ratios has moved materially over the past four periods to 31 Jul 2026.
